reviewDisposition.scope: Full static art/layout review followed by scoring only its early-warning contrast correction; six affected views reopened and all 21 recaptures decoded.
reviewDisposition.limitations: Not a new whole-surface review, official Impeccable gate, numerical fidelity score, hardware/motion assessment or Android release approval.

officialCompGates.reason: Official launcher/role definitions, QUALITY BAR, measured comp spec and closed comp/plates/hero/diff gate evidence unavailable.

documenter.role: fresh independent agent using degraded documenter definition
documenter.writes: Design documentation and development state only; no runtime, source PNG, test, README or original review edits.

unmeasured: physical Pixel sustained performance, heat and battery
motion/impact quality in the static review
